propositions: GET-rotation stamps must be moved from inline bindings.json to a dedicated .bridge_state/get_rotation.json sidecar file to reduce bloat of the large sort-ordered bindings collection.
New binaries must write rotation state to both the sidecar and legacy inline field, and read the chronological max() of both, to maintain forward/backward compatibility during mixed-version rollout.

Rotation state sidecar must be persisted only through BindingStore.save() to cover all production paths (end-of-pass, write-ahead saves in dispatch_one.py, recovery/retirement in binding_store.py) while keeping reconcile-check with persist=False from creating the file.

The new get_rotation.py module must remain a cohesive load/canonicalize/max/dual-write/save cluster at the BindingStore persistence seam, respecting the locked 800-line policy for binding_store.py and outbound_differ.py.

Git staging and reconciliation must treat .bridge_state/get_rotation.json as an explicit tracked file (via git_adapter.GET_ROTATION_FILE, staging list, and basename checks) because local reconciliation does not use git add -A.

Lexicographic max() of fixed-width zero-padded timestamp values must correctly implement chronological ordering across old-binary/new-binary interleaved sequences, and legacy-only stores must materialize equivalent sidecar state on next persisted save.
